title: Challenging Quadratic Attention$\unicode{x2013}$A Holistic View on the Rise of Alternative Language Model Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2510.05364v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformers have dominated sequence processing tasks for the past seven years$\unicode{x2013}$most notably language modeling. However, the inherent quadratic complexity of their attention mechanism remains a significant bottleneck as context length increases. We review and distill the recent efforts to overcome this bottleneck, including advances in (sub-quadratic) attention variants, recurrent neural networks, state space models, and hybrid architectures. We critically analyze approaches regarding compute and memory complexity, benchmark results, and fundamental limitations to assess whether the dominance of pure-attention transformers may soon be challenged, which we consider possible, particularly in domain-specific and edge-device applications.

translated_title: 挑战二次复杂度注意力——替代性语言模型架构崛起的全景综述
translated_abstract: 在过去七年中，Transformer 一直主导着序列处理任务——尤其是在语言建模领域。然而，其注意力机制固有的二次复杂度随着上下文长度的增加仍是显著的瓶颈。我们回顾并提炼了近期为克服这一瓶颈所做出的努力，包括（亚二次复杂度）注意力变体、循环神经网络、状态空间模型以及混合架构等方面的进展。我们从计算与内存复杂度、基准测试结果以及根本局限性等角度对这些方法进行了批判性分析，以评估纯注意力 Transformer 的主导地位是否可能很快受到挑战。我们认为这是可能的，尤其是在特定领域和边缘设备应用中。
tldr: 本文综述了亚二次注意力变体、循环神经网络、状态空间模型及混合架构等替代性语言模型架构的最新进展，并认为纯注意力 Transformer 的主导地位可能被挑战，尤其是在特定领域和边缘设备应用中。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews recent alternative language model architectures—including sub-quadratic attention variants, RNNs, state space models, and hybrids—and argues that the dominance of pure-attention transformers may soon be challenged, particularly in domain-specific and edge-device applications.
